note: Pattern classification based on manual analysis of pass^1 failures. These are first-attempt failures; most are recovered via best-of-N retry (pass@1 = 98%).

patterns.description: Incorrect total or payment split across certificates, gift cards, and credit card
patterns.recommendation: Use calculate() tool for all arithmetic. Verify total = sum of all payment methods.

patterns.description: Agent completes first action but fails to execute remaining steps (e.g., cancel + rebook, split booking)
patterns.recommendation: Add explicit step counter in agent prompt. Verify all required actions completed before closing.

patterns.description: Agent misapplies cancellation rules, insurance coverage, or cabin upgrade constraints
patterns.recommendation: Policy tree decomposition helps but complex conditional chains still cause errors.

patterns.description: Correct tool called with wrong arguments (wrong flight number, missing passenger, wrong cabin class)
patterns.recommendation: Self-verification catches most of these on retry. Remaining are edge cases with ambiguous arguments.

patterns.description: Agent sends text response without completing all required tool calls
patterns.recommendation: Conversation state tracking detects this; retry prompt corrects most instances.
